description: Whether the top bar's account button shows the user's display name next to the avatar (TmTopBar.UserNameDisplay).

values.name: Auto
values.description: The default: the name shows on a wide bar and hides when the bar's own box narrows below 480px (the avatar and the menu behind it stay). The breakpoint is a container query on the bar itself, never the viewport.

values.name: Always
values.description: The name renders at every width; on a narrow bar it ellipsises instead of hiding.

values.name: Never
values.description: The name never renders; the account button is the avatar alone (the localized accessible name on the button is the only naming).
